findings.title: Fail-loud font guard is dead code — the silent raylib-default fallback remains possible (lens-guard C violated)
findings.evidence: load_font_file: glyphs,count := font_merge_fallback(...); f := font_from_glyphs(glyphs, count, ...); if rl.IsFontValid(f) { return f }; return rl.GetFontDefault()  // font_from_glyphs: if glyphs == nil || count == 0 { return rl.GetFontDefault() } ... if atlas.data == nil { return rl.GetFontDefault() } — and app/main.odin: if !rl.IsFontValid(app.view.font) || ... { os.exit(2) } can never fire (the default font is valid)
findings.detail: Every load failure (missing TTF, unreadable bytes, empty glyph set, failed atlas) is coerced to rl.GetFontDefault() BEFORE the guards; the default passes IsFontValid, so the refusal path is unreachable. The A/B-gallery lesson ('the Plex frames were silently Open Sans') can recur undetected.
findings.recommended_fix: Make load_font_file return (Font, ok: bool) or detect the default (compare texture/glyphCount vs GetFontDefault) and exit loudly in app + harness + palcheck; add a test that a missing asset actually exits 2.

findings.title: PR #87 body (and committed _pr_body_font_overhaul.md) carries the WRONG job's content — the blender-silhouettes PR body
findings.evidence: '# MM-minimal silhouette spec + validated re-render pipeline (work-start release)' + '**Perkins r1 (review 5000528400): CHANGES_REQUESTED**' + 'No goldens touched' — while this diff rewrites 111 golden PNGs and is the font-overhaul job
findings.detail: The merge surface would permanently record another job's body, including its Perkins verdict and a now-false 'No goldens touched' claim. Required proofs are missing from the body: hash-equal T1/replay proof (job rule 5), re-bless cause documentation, before/after header evidence pointers (all exist in the commit message + docs/captures but not on the PR surface).
findings.recommended_fix: Rewrite the PR body from the commit message + docs/captures/v2-font-overhaul/ evidence: family rationale, size ladder, ink_soft/NOC contrast folds, T1/replay hash-equal proof, re-bless cause, ⚠ fallback pins. Fix or drop the committed _pr_body file.

findings.title: noc-e2e TakeScreenshot moved BEFORE EndDrawing — the pinned unflushed-batch lesson regressed, and both comment layers now state the opposite of the code
findings.evidence: when #config(PP_DEBUG, false) { if app.noc_e2e { ... rl.TakeScreenshot(...) } } runs, THEN: when #config(PP_DEBUG, false) { rl.EndDrawing() ... } — while the comment says 'AFTER EndDrawing: a mid-frame TakeScreenshot can miss the unflushed rlgl batch' and the new text claims 'this block runs after the flush in both' + 'EndTextureMode in gallery mode' (no EndTextureMode exists anywhere)
findings.detail: In PP_DEBUG builds the e2e captures now fire pre-flush — exactly the stale-frame bug the v2-noc D-lesson pinned (harness captures after EndDrawing for that reason). Debug-only (gitignored artifacts, no golden/gate impact) but the verification tool's evidence becomes unreliable and three comments are false.
findings.recommended_fix: Move the noc_e2e block after the EndDrawing calls (or capture via LoadImageFromScreen post-flush as font_check does); fix the comments (EndDrawing in both modes).

findings.title: glyph_probe indexes raylib's COMPACTED glyph array by codepoint position — the ⚠ verdict reads past the array (garbage) for exactly the fonts that lack the glyph
findings.evidence: for i in 0..<n { cp := cps[i]; g := f.glyphs[i] ... } — raylib LoadFontEx compacts missing codepoints (view.odin's own merge comment documents this); a font lacking U+26A0 returns 95 glyphs, so f.glyphs[95] is an unchecked multi-pointer over-read
findings.detail: Per-codepoint verdicts misalign once any codepoint is missing; the U+26A0 line — the probe's entire purpose — prints garbage box/advance for the negative case it exists to diagnose. The authoritative pin (font_test.odin, value-keyed) is correct, so no shipped miscoverage.
findings.recommended_fix: Look glyphs up by value (scan f.glyphs[0..f.glyphCount) for value == cp, like font_probe_warning does) or use rl.GetGlyphIndex.

findings.title: font-check baseline probe targets assets/fonts/open_sans_regular.ttf — deleted by this same diff
findings.evidence: glyph_probe("assets/fonts/open_sans_regular.ttf", rnd.FONT_BASE_SIZE) — and the diff deletes the file (Bin 130484 -> 0 bytes)
findings.detail: On the settled head the baseline comparison always prints 'cannot load' and silently degrades to a notice — the A/B baseline leg of the verb is dead code.
findings.recommended_fix: Point the baseline at a committed font (Plex Sans or the Noto fallback) or make the baseline optional/arg-driven.

findings.title: run_demo_to_ms added as the 'shared' replay driver while overlay_check keeps its own inline copy of the identical loop
findings.evidence: overlay_check: wall_max := min(u64(max(0, i64(cap_ms) * i64(hz) / 1000)), total_wall); for w in u64(1)..=wall_max { ... paused_at(cfg.pauses[:], w, hz) — and run_demo_to_ms repeats the same loop verbatim; the doc comment block is pasted twice

findings.title: font_merge_fallback leaks the fallback glyph ARRAY block (fg) after copying its structs into merged
findings.evidence: merged[count + j] = fg[j] ... rl.MemFree(glyphs) // the main block freed — but fg (the fallback's array block) is never MemFree'd; the per-glyph image data ownership is correct, only the block leaks
findings.detail: One small block per font per init (3 in app, 3 per harness render_setup, 2 per font_test run) via raylib MemAlloc — invisible to Odin's leak tracker; harmless in practice, real leak by ownership rules.
findings.recommended_fix: rl.MemFree(fg) after the copy loop (the structs are shallow-copied; the block itself has no other owner).

findings.title: missing[8] cap silently drops fallback coverage beyond 8 codepoints
findings.evidence: missing: [8]rune ... if !found && missing_n < len(missing) { missing[missing_n] = cp ... } — no overflow signal
findings.detail: Today's set misses only U+26A0 (1), but a future codepoint set with >8 gaps silently renders blanks instead of failing loudly.
findings.recommended_fix: Assert/panic on overflow (the loader's fail-loud doctrine) or size the array from len(cps).
